input.summary: Extend the hosting licence to Customer affiliates and contractors acting on its behalf
input.comment: [Playbook] Our licences must cover our affiliates and the contractors we use to deliver the Corio Services (consistent with Section 14.8), so we have added them to the grant; the perpetual/irrevocable nature and successor transfer under Section 14.1 are unchanged. Fallback: affiliates covered on written notice to Commerce One.

ops.oldText: Commerce One hereby grants to Corio a fee-bearing, perpetual and irrevocable, nonexclusive, nontransferable
ops.newText: Commerce One hereby grants to Corio and its affiliates and contractors acting on its behalf a fee-bearing, perpetual and irrevocable, nonexclusive, nontransferable

input.summary: Extend the software warranty to 12 months from delivery and remove the fixed calendar cut-off
input.comment: [Playbook] A 60-day warranty running from the Effective Date (and expiring on a fixed calendar date) gives us almost no coverage for a five-year hosted deployment, so we have set the Warranty Period at twelve (12) months from delivery. Fallback: ninety (90) days from delivery with the same repair/replace/refund remedies.

ops.oldText: for a period of sixty (60) days from the Effective Date, but in no event not later than December 31, 1999 (the "Warranty Period")
ops.newText: for a period of twelve (12) months from the date of delivery of the Software (the "Warranty Period")
